approval: Buddy, September27 2026, S321: active multi-path investigation and podcast lead tracing approved. Existing cap/schedule retained; no external contact.
mission: Investigate drivers, childhood onset and durable ways to stop follicle-directed immune attack. Generate falsifiable research hypotheses; distinguish initiation, persistence and relapse. Do not assume one identifiable trigger or infer an individual cause from age. Propose research directions, not patient interventions.

paths.question: Why childhood onset? Timing, predisposition and alternatives
What maintains disease after a trigger disappears?
Research directions toward remission after treatment withdrawal
Follow the podcast to public lab research
